notes: §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR26 (Amendment 2): "If the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful, the physical file is not affected", then a. the I-O status is set and b. "Any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed." SequentialIoEmitter#EmitOpen emits per file-name the runtime OPEN, the FILE STATUS store and then EmitUseHook, whose selector (UseTierEmitter#EmitScopeTiers) takes the file-name procedure first and otherwise the procedure of FileRegistry#OpenModeOf, the mode being opened, which FileConnector#OpenOnce and, for status 38, SharedOpenAttempt record (kb/Work PB5200, landed: the prior PARTIAL); RefusedAsAlreadyOpen and SequentialConnector#OpenCore refuse before touching the file. Probes at --std 85: e) OPEN INPUT then I-O naming a sequential, a relative and an indexed absent file run the INPUT then the I-O procedure once per file in order, each seeing its 35, none created; EXTEND of an absent file 35 to the EXTEND procedure; OUTPUT into a missing directory 30; OUTPUT and EXTEND of a read-only file 37 with the content unchanged; OUTPUT of a file open INPUT 41 to the file-name procedure, its record still read back; OUTPUT and INPUT of a file closed WITH LOCK 38 to the OUTPUT and INPUT procedures, also for a file with no FILE STATUS; a GLOBAL USE of the containing program takes a contained program's failed OPEN; control continues after the OPEN, a READ after the failed OPEN gives 47; with no FILE STATUS and no USE the run unit ends abnormally; c) >>TURN, USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION and EC-I-O are refused at 85 (COBOL0900, COBOL0877, COBOL0878). a), b), d) and f) do not reach this rule. The witness covers 35 and 41 with file-name procedures. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5200 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 (1993 amendment): an unsuccessful OPEN leaves 'the physical file' unaffected, then 'a. A value is placed in the I-O status', then 'b. Any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed.' §2023:14.9.27.4 GR25 keeps 'the file is not affected', a) the I-O status, and d) 'Any applicable USE FOR EXCEPTION or USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed', but adds cases: b) 'If it is enabled, the level-3 EC-I-O exception condition ... is set to exist', and c) an OPEN in an exception-checking PERFORM with an applicable WHEN phrase continues at that WHEN phrase and 'No applicable USE declarative is executed'. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 runs USE procedures only when the statement is outside an exception-checking PERFORM or no WHEN matched. Those programs (>>TURN, exception-checking PERFORM, USE FOR EXCEPTION) are accepted by 2023 and refused by 1985, and for them the result differs: a case added, so CHANGED. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR1 restates the I-O status update.
